effective_spec.overview: 完整 catalog／版本解析／pin／引用根生命週期一次確認候選；保留已驗收S1，不宣稱完整素材/GC/媒體模組完成。

architecture.intent: M05 owns project-scoped immutable material identity, verified versions, durable pins and derived reference manifests. It must resolve explicit references without losing versions used by documents/history/recovery.
architecture.hexagonal_view: Editor/Test → Tauri material commands → DispatchHost MaterialOwner → HOST AssetCatalog use cases → MaterialStorePort + existing FileCommitPort + authoritative RootProvider inputs. WORK S1 evaluate_asset_retention stays pure and unchanged. WindowsMaterialStore implements only new material storage interface.
architecture.dependency_view: M03 design facade/M04 single DocumentOwner → M05 application resolution/pin input port → HOST AssetCatalog. M04/M07/transaction owners → registered root-provider seam → M05 root projection → accepted WORK retention policy. UI never accesses adapter/store or supplies trusted roots.

owners.M05 MaterialOwner: Application per-project coordinator, authorization, provider epochs and project-store handle. No competing document state.
owners.M05 HOST: Catalog schema validation, resolve/pin/transfer/index transition rules.
owners.M05 adapter: Safe immutable blob publication/read and store identity; journal semantics delegated to existing FileCommit adapter for index only.
owners.M04 DocumentOwner: Sole S1 document session, content/history/revisions and captured save evidence.
owners.M03: Candidate binding/Viewer projections through M04 owner; not catalog owner.
owners.M07: Recovery payload/index publication proof; not implemented by this package.
owners.WORK S1: Retain/eligible decision only; eligibility still not deletion authority.

architecture.mutation: Only MaterialOwner invokes catalog transitions under project catalog lease; only corresponding document owner invokes S1 content commit. Resolution is read-only; durable pin acquisition is a separate explicit operation.
architecture.transactions: One catalog index is the atomic metadata boundary. Blob publication precedes index publication. Document bytes and catalog index are NOT one atomic transaction; durable pins bridge gaps. Never promise rollback of a committed document when pin promotion fails.
architecture.cross_process: Each index transition holds existing FileCommitPort acquire_write on catalog path; adapter handles OS exclusion/journal inspection. Lease+CAS protect catalog across processes. Immutable blob publication is create-if-absent and verify existing digest; no overwrite/remove API. Process-local mutex alone insufficient.
forbidden: M05 mutates M04 content or ACK
M04 uses catalog raw hash as semantic baseline
reuse S1 eligibility as physical delete grant
manual writes to IO private journal
architecture.approval: PROPOSED; diagrams and new Ports await Owner. New adapter scope requires explicit approval, not inherited IO approval.

schema.storage: Project-owned .sgenaxis/materials/catalog.v1.json; immutable objects .sgenaxis/materials/objects/<lowerhex SHA256>.blob. OS adapter binds project/store directory handle identities, not UI strings. These paths are new proposal, not IO private journal paths.

catalog_fields.generation: u64; initial0; each effective index commit checked+1

asset_record.legacy_aliases: exact UTF8 strings registered by trusted project migration only; unique within project, never auto-trim/casefold/path interpretation

version_record.digest: lowerhex64 SHA256 exact blob bytes; identity=(asset_id,digest)
version_record.media_type: opaque declared MIME ASCII1..128bytes; not proof of decoder support
version_record.status: Published only; staged objects never visible in index

pin_record.state: Held|Transferred|Released; Held only temporary authority; terminal transition receipt immutable.
pin_record.transfer_receipt: optional immutable target root IDs+receipt digest

root_manifest.kind: one of accepted S1 five RootKind values
root_manifest.source_revision: opaque producer revision, not numeric ordered across owners
root_manifest.evidence: Opaque owner-authenticated receipt/file/capture attestation; UI cannot issue

schema.operation_record: {operation_id, caller_binding, input_digest, result_kind, receipt_digest, generation}; immutable replay record. Results include Published|Pinned|Transferred|Released. Same ID/different digest conflicts. No eviction/restart forgetfulness.
schema.canonical_index: UTF8 compact JSON, schema field order as above; record fields fixed in declared order; all arrays sorted by ID UTF8 bytes (versions by digest; root references by asset_id,digest,owner_id). Reject unknown/duplicate fields, wrong types, floats for integer fields, invalid UTF8/BOM/NUL IDs, digest mismatch; no ignored fields. Strict raw parse before typed decode. Index raw SHA used only CAS, never M03/M04 semantic digest.
schema.counting: All limits inclusive; lengths UTF8 bytes, no character-count substitution. Request count checked before dedup; persisted total checked after exact dedup. Index output bytes checked by counting writer before commit. All new bounds are Owner choices. Saturation fails before mutating index; no implicit removal, pin expiry or GC.

transition_receipts.schema: SGA-MATERIAL-RECEIPT-v1 (new catalog index transition_receipts record; pending schema adoption)

fields.result: Tagged terminal Pin|Imported|Transferred|Released; no runtime DocumentMutation success here

transition_receipts.atomicity: Record and pin/root transition in same catalog raw commit. Logical catalog_generation/target_identity verify inclusion without circular embedding of own raw digest. External raw CommitReceipt kept as issuer evidence, not hashed into the same committed bytes.
transition_receipts.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
transition_receipts.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

external_issuers.M04: FormalSaveProof requires IO receipt+M05 transfer+captured semantic ACK; runtime owner replay loss => UnverifiedOutcome unless all issuer evidence actually revalidated. MutationReceipt runtime only.
external_issuers.M07: Immutable attempt/payload/index receipt; LocalIntegrityReady independent source ACK.
external_issuers.M01: final path Ready marker and matching digests; not inherited source approval.

application_inputs.import: import(WorkflowContext,TrustedSourceSelection,ImportMetadata,TransitionKey)->ImportedPinnedManifest; native source bytes verified before durable immutable import; no UI path authority
application_inputs.register_roots: register_roots(TrustedProviderCapability,RootKind)->RootRegistration; internal trusted composition only; no UI registration/callback
application_inputs.publish_roots: publish_roots(RootRegistration,expected_epoch:u64,RootManifest,TransitionKey)->RootObservationReceipt; owner provider attests current fenced manifest; stale epoch => StaleRoots, unknown => Unknown not empty

ports.ResolutionContext: Server-derived immutable WorkflowContext {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:U64,captured_revision:U64,workflow_id:UUID}; no transition operation_id in context. Runtime authority never comes from labels/DTO.
ports.ReferenceRequest: {source_path,kind:Asset|Binding,opaque_id,pinned_digest?:lowerhex64,target_id?:string}; exact M04 proposed shape. Require explicit pinned version for execution/save; trusted legacy map may supply sole explicit pinned pair, never latest/head fallback.
ports.ResolutionSnapshot: {Context,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; no root_proof_id; complete resolution is neither pin nor root completeness.

MaterialStorePort.existing: bind_store/inspect_identity/index_target/import_blob/verify_blob remain under original narrowed candidate restrictions

read_verified_blob.grant: Crate-private trusted constructor in M05 application composition: immutable store_identity,pin_id,workflow_id,asset_id,digest,size,pin_catalog_generation; issued only after verified Held or Transferred pin membership. Released pin denied. Not deserializable from UI.
read_verified_blob.preconditions: 0 < max_bytes <= M05 existing admitted blob limit; expected_size<=max_bytes; grant exact pair/size/store matches. Acquire safe native immutable object handle, reject alias/reparse/size/hash mismatch, no path/URI returned as authority.
read_verified_blob.result: VerifiedBlobRead {store_identity,digest,size_bytes,immutable bounded bytes or guarded read handle}. Stream exactly expected_size, hash entire bytes before consumer install/export. Handle lifetime owns source access; no reopen-by-path.
read_verified_blob.side_effects: No catalog mutation, repair, delete, overwrite, fallback/latest mapping or arbitrary read. Release blocked by retained pin/fence until read operation ends.

MaterialStorePort.forbidden: No arbitrary path reads, remove/overwrite/repair or public FileCommitPort change

ports.BlobReceipt: {store_identity,digest,size_bytes,publication:Created|VerifiedExisting}; success requires full bytes hash, safe native handle, flushed blob and durable directory entry. Existing digest with different size/bytes/corrupt object is IntegrityFailure, never replaced.
ports.RootProviderPort: observe(registration, expected_epoch) -> RootManifest; fence(producer_revision) -> RootFence token; validate(fence) -> Current|Changed|Unknown. Ownership-specific facade implements it; no arbitrary external callback dispatched from UI.
ports.composition: HOST depends abstractions; Tauri constructs WindowsMaterialStore + existing FileCommit adapter. New sgenaxis-ports material_store.rs contains storage data/trait; application contracts in HOST asset_store.rs. Existing FileCommitPort public signatures unchanged.
ports.native_safety: All store/source/objects handles identity-bound; reject reparse/8.3/hardlink identity ambiguity and path escape, unexpected link count, nonregular objects, sharing violations. Never trust lexical containment alone. Native adapter capabilities must be tested on Windows11 x64 before readiness. Other OS UnsupportedPlatform.
ports.clock_ids: IDs minted by application injected opaque ID source; collisions checked under lease; no timestamp uniqueness assumption. No automatic expiration; monotonic clock only for UI preview optional, never pin release.
ports.resolution_independence: Complete asset/binding inventory resolution independent from all-five-root completeness. Pure HOST projector supplies identities; no call into M03 runtime. Missing M07/root provider remains Unknown, retains pins but does not prevent pinned valid installs.

call_mapping.material_import: trusted source selection → import → immutable blob receipt → catalog pin+receipt same CAS
call_mapping.export_or_snapshot: validate_pin → issue private VerifiedStorePinGrant → driven read_verified_blob → verify bytes → consumer
call_mapping.registration: trusted application composition → register_roots; closed RootKind LiveDocuments|UndoRedo|FormalDocuments|RecoverySnapshots|ExportImportOperations
call_mapping.publish: provider current epoch/fence → publish_roots; stale/Unknown does not authorize release

import: Authorize project+source selection; verify store identity; acquire catalog lease; strict read+validate index and raw digest (missing index permitted only explicit initialization).

Stream selected source through safe immutable-blob adapter; reject empty/>64MiB; exact digest. No decoder execution, SVG fetching, script execution or MIME-based execution. Media rendering format support remains separate.
Publish new immutable object durably; adapter verifies existing object if hash already exists. Until index commit it is unreachable orphan, never user-visible Published.
Construct AssetRecord/version plus durable Import pin and operation replay record in one next index; generation+1; validate all capacities/output bytes; replace_checked previous raw digest.

Verify CommitReceipt target/previous/new digest and transaction_id; PublishedVersion contains receipt+pin. Failure before index commit leaves old index; orphan retained. Commit uncertain blocks catalog mutations and preserves blob evidence; never delete orphan as rollback.
transactions.resolve_pin: Resolve names from validated current index; verify every referenced blob identity/hash/size and all target binding evidence. Obtain complete snapshot. Pin takes exclusive index lease; exact snapshot generation/raw hash check then persist Held pin+operation in next index. Durable pin receipt only after verified index commit. Any concurrent index update yields StaleCatalog (caller may explicitly resolve again); no silent latest-version change.
transactions.candidate_install: M03 candidate → M04 validated candidate/expected revision → M05 resolve+pin Candidate → owner rechecks generation/revision and pin validity → one existing S1 commit. Before content commit failure may request release; after commit publish LiveDocuments/Undo/Redo root observations then transfer pin. If root publication fails, content remains installed with Held pin; report InstalledRetentionDeferred, block later destructive retention actions; no fake rollback.
transactions.formal_save: Verified file receipt→authenticated FormalFile proof→M05 root transfer durable→M04 captured semantic ACK; failure CommittedAckDeferred with Held and exact proof.
transactions.save_proof: CommitEvidence {project,document,session,generation,captured_revision,semantic_profile,semantic_digest,raw_encoded_digest,previous_raw_digest?,target_identity,transaction_id,pin_id,versions_digest}. M05 authenticates originating owner and exact pin/versions/context; it does not independently certify arbitrary receipt or update document baseline.
transactions.undo_redo: M04 publishes complete union roots for live/Undo/Redo atomically in one catalog transition; old roots retained until new root set durable. Undo never deletes bytes. S1 before+after required asset pairs remain unchanged. If publication fails keep previous roots +Held candidate pin; unknown/new roots conservatively retain.
transactions.recovery: M07 must pin before payload publication, then transfer only after payload+index receipt confirmed. Snapshot removal does not release pin without updated complete root manifest/fence. No real scheduler/recovery writer implemented here; unavailable M07 provider remains Unknown.
transactions.release: Check exact pin owner/purpose and generation, all five root-provider observations present, Complete and current under fences. If any unknown/stale/registered provider missing => Retained{reasons}, no removal. Otherwise update only temporary pin metadata to Released via index transition; asset records/blobs remain. Referenced versions remain protected by root manifests. No physical deletion or automatic orphan sweep in this slice.
transactions.crash: Published durable Held pins survive restart. Partial blob import may leave unindexed/temp object; retain for explicit future reconciliation. Journal RecoveryRequired/mismatched receipt => project MaterialRecoveryBlocked; no new root trust/import/release. Existing catalog inspect read may expose diagnostics, never execute unverified references. Recovery/repair new transaction is separate proposal.
transactions.replay: operation_id1..128ASCII bound to authenticated caller and hash of exact canonical request. Identical completed request returns stored result/proof; different body ReplayConflict. Index uncertain => PendingRecovery, not a retry. IDs remain persisted (8192 cap), no silent eviction. Durable operation receipt lookup rechecks project/role; revoked caller denied.
transactions.cross_index_limit: No simultaneous durable atomic commit across catalog and document/snapshot. Pins make intermediate states safe by retention, not by pretending multi-file atomicity. Reconciliation can promote retained pins from verified evidence later; never fabricate a successful ACK.
transactions.project_copy: Catalog/pins initialized at FINAL QuarantinedCopy path; never move journal-bearing directory. Ready marker after all native/catalog/definition/doc proofs; source namespace may not be adopted as destination.

proof_authority.ResolutionSnapshot: {Context,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; no root_proof_id; complete resolution is neither pin nor root completeness.
proof_authority.VerifiedBundle: {context,source_digest,entries:[asset_id,digest,size_bytes,verified_bytes_or_handle],legacy_alias_mapping}; all raw bytes/hash/closure validated by trusted issuer.
proof_authority.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer_receipt_id resolves server record {issuer,operation_kind,Context,target_identity,receipt/raw/projection evidence}; durable proof must be revalidated after restart; UI DTO never carries trusted receipt content.
proof_authority.TransferReceipt: {issuer:M05,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,root_manifest_ids,external_proof_id,Context,receipt_id}; original Held transitions only after verified durable catalog commit.
proof_authority.VerifiedBytes: {digest,size_bytes,immutable_bytes_or_guarded_handle,store_identity}; issued only native/hash validator, not URI/path trust.

roots_lifecycle.LiveDocuments: Includes all current document owners AND persisted formal-document version manifests in authorized project, including closed documents. Provider must attest complete project coverage; current-window scan insufficient. Missing persisted-document inventory => Unknown. Durable manifests are derived receipts, not alternate editable content.
roots_lifecycle.registration: MaterialOwner registers provider IDs, scope and epoch from trusted composition. Need every registered provider for each kind; aggregating all providers yields one S1 RootObservation per kind. Any missing/incomplete component makes kind Unknown. Never omit unready M07 merely to claim completeness.
roots_lifecycle.epochs: Project switch/window detach invalidates registration epoch. Old proof cannot replace new epoch. Closing a session first publishes retained history/formal roots or marks Unknown; dropping memory is not root deletion proof.
roots_lifecycle.freshness: Freeze all relevant producer revisions via RootFence; if any producer cannot fence, retention/release returns Retained Unknown. Do not hold catalog lock while calling providers: collect fences first, acquire lease then validate all fences. Never wait for document lock while holding catalog lock. Owner pins before adding refs, root transitions only after pin receipt.
roots_lifecycle.s1_mapping: Exactly five aggregated observations and expected revisions supplied to accepted evaluate_asset_retention; use completeness Unknown on any provider gap. Do not add enum variants, relax validation or alter S1 test expectations. S1 EligibleForCleanup still only eligibility.
roots_lifecycle.pin_lifecycle: Unindexed staging → durable Held (before external content references) → Transferred (new root manifests committed in same catalog index) OR safe Released. Owner loss/crash/timeout never releases Held. Replayed transfer verifies immutable original proof and returns same transfer receipt. No wall-clock TTL.
roots_lifecycle.physical_gc: DEFERRED_SEPARATE_ENVELOPE. Needs native deletion fence, recovery and complete inventory; no remove method, no delete command, no reclaimed-byte claim. Catalog retention capacity/full disk risks surfaced without weakening safety.

binding_save_integration.M03: Reference extractor supplied by adopted C1/H2 validates supported fields; Editor selection/Viewer mock is ephemeral and creates no asset pin/root. Viewer cannot import/pin/release/mutate roots. Binding state changes persisted only as explicit document content edit through M04 owner.
binding_save_integration.legacy: M04 exact XML assetRef text maps through explicit trusted catalog legacy_aliases to immutable pair. Migration registration requires owner-confirmed mapping with digest; no trim or filename/path auto-resolution. Ambiguous/missing alias fails UnmappedReference. Unknown props never guessed.
binding_save_integration.targets: Internal target IDs checked against candidate entity set; external target requires trusted binding provider evidence echoing project/document/revision. Valid target absent => MissingTarget; explicitly authored Pending is preserved and blocks execute/build while edit/save allowed only assets fully pinned. Invalid/unknown binding blocks install/save. Duplicate binding ID error, never dedup losing behavior.
joint_amendments: Effective common MutationReceipt and formal transfer-before-ACK now materialized in this proposal; original package history preserved.
binding_save_integration.authorization: These are proposed coordinated amendments to pending packets; original files/revisions remain frozen. Adoption of M05 alone cannot silently amend M03/M04 or authorize their implementations.

errors.result: Tagged Result<Success,MaterialError>; success/error mutually exclusive. Deferred external-commit result explicitly carries document/catalog receipts; cannot report unchanged failure.
errors.shape: MaterialError {code,stage,path,reason,operation_id?,details}; path is JSON pointer or opaque source_path; unauthorized callers receive no OS paths/blob contents.
errors.precedence: caller/project authorization → closed DTO/type/UTF8/count prechecks → store identity → catalog lease/read/journal → strict schema/input guards in JSON encounter order → request replay → generation/capacity → exact resolution/binding → blob verification → root freshness/pin ownership → proposed index output checks → index IO receipt verification. First failing stage wins; no extra IO after error.
errors.error_detail: CommitError variant fields preserved exactly, including RecoveryRequired target/journal/old/new paths and reason. Blob errors stage=SourceOpen|Copy|Hash|Flush|Publish|Verify. Catalog Resource includes token,limit,observed,path; root path /. Per-array error points /assets/i etc in input encounter order; normalized sorting only after validation.
errors.failure_policy: Before index commit: previous valid index remains; orphan blob may remain. After verified index commit: Published/Pinned receipt survives response loss. Uncertain commit: retain all evidence and block; never claim old index unchanged. No automatic retry, expiry, repair or physical deletion.

ui.internal_only: resolve/pin/transfer/release/publish_roots and legacy alias registration are application ports, NOT Tauri arbitrary invoke commands. No Viewer or automation grant inherited from label.
ui.schema: Editor material panel shows immutable asset/version/digest, verification status, pin/root reasons and pending proof. Import disabled without trusted source/project binding or blocked store; failed import preserves existing list. No delete/cleanup button in this slice. Paging max100 records, cursor server-issued bound to catalog generation; stale cursor StaleCatalog.
ui.a11y: Keyboard import/select version; status aria-live; failure preserves selection, details access restricted; pending is never success icon.
ui.media_scope: Opaque bytes catalog/import support does not imply PNG/JPEG/SVG/video decode/render safety or broad media matrix adoption. Viewer active content, executable SVG and remote references remain prohibited; separate approved renderer validates before preview.

decisions.proposal: Adopt catalog schema, bounds and immutable explicit version/alias identity; raw catalog hash distinct from semantic fingerprints.
Adopt MaterialStorePort and Windows adapter +existing FileCommit index transaction; no generic FS bypass or IO journal change.
Adopt durable pin-before-reference and receipt-bearing transfer/release with no timeout expiry.
Adopt all five provider aggregation/epoch/fence lifecycle, persisted formal-document roots and Unknown conservative behavior; preserve accepted S1.
Adopt proposed M03/M04 amendments for candidate deferred retention and save promotion-before-ACK, explicit binding projector contract.
Adopt no physical GC/repair/automatic media execution in this slice; retain requirements as separate tasks, not module-complete.
Adopt closed UI/internal ACL, error/replay/capacity policies and exact candidate envelope/test gates.

model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

matrix.after: RecoverySnapshots root transfer→S1 Published+captured recovery ACK

model.precedence: Only after Owner adoption: v3 exact schema roots/full request bodies/error lifecycle override corresponding v2 definitions and historical descriptors. Original packages immutable. No adoption, product readiness or executable evidence implied.

wire_types.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_types.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.
wire_types.OpaqueId: ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; native/generated fixed-format IDs retain module constraint; actual context server-derived.
wire_types.Context: Server-derived immutable WorkflowContext {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:U64,captured_revision:U64,workflow_id:UUID}; no transition operation_id in context. Runtime authority never comes from labels/DTO.

material_api.publish_roots: publish_roots(RootRegistration,expected_epoch:u64,RootManifest,TransitionKey)->RootObservationReceipt; owner provider attests current fenced manifest; stale epoch => StaleRoots, unknown => Unknown not empty

quarantine_copy.marker: .sgenaxis/copy-state.v1.json; {schema:SGA-PROJECT-COPY-v1,project_uuid,operation_id,state:Quarantined|Ready,definition_raw_digest?,document_raw_digest?,catalog_raw_digest?,manifest_digest?}. Strict duplicate/unknown/type/project validation; quarantine written durably before any public project manifest/definition/document/catalog.
quarantine_copy.sequence: Exclusive create FINAL target directory (never rename it after any FileCommit operation) → create Quarantined marker via checked IO → initialize validated children/catalog/pins at FINAL paths → verify full copy proofs → CAS Ready marker with exact digests → authenticate M01 open/bind. Source approvals provenance only; new project+doc identities.
quarantine_copy.reader_gate: All official M01 open/adopt/select and startup recovery check copy marker before S2 bind; Quarantined/invalid/uncertain journal refuses project readiness. Marker absent allows existing legacy policy only if no partial-copy evidence; empty/unmarked exclusive-copy crash residue is not adopted automatically. Existing accepted S2 public API unchanged; new application wrapper gate is proposed.
quarantine_copy.failure: Before Ready no selectable completed project; retains quarantined diagnostic+pins. After Ready delivery loss returns ProjectCopyDeliveryDeferred; no rollback/delete. Never rewrite/move private journal to fix path binding.

source_reservation.application_trait: SourceReadReservation: snapshot_id()->SourceSnapshotId; validate_held()->Result<SourceSnapshotId,SourceFenceError>; explicit release(self). Owns authenticated snapshot identity+held producer read capability; cannot be constructed from DTO. Drop releases handles only.
source_reservation.native_trait: CommittedReadPort.acquire_read(trusted_target_capability)->CommittedReadLease; lease.read_verified(max_bytes)->VerifiedCommittedBytes; lease owns OS shared lock compatible with existing FileCommit exclusive writer, normalized target+readonly journal validation. No create/repair/cleanup. Missing sidecar =>Unavailable.
source_reservation.producer_rules: Definition/design owner read reservation blocks their mutation and exclusive file writer until generation terminal result; acquire definition→approval HOST epoch→design before active writer. Immutable SPEC Approved revisions remain pure; HOST epoch covers evidence validity changes, not a SPEC filesystem dependency. All producer mutation routes must honor reservation; incomplete coverage =>DependencyNotReady.
source_reservation.io_guard: IO-owned crate-private CommittedReadGuard unforgeable outside adapter constructor. inspect_committed_locked(&CommittedReadGuard)->Result<CommittedReadInspection,CommitError>; validates guard-bound canonical target/terminal journal/current raw digest, no path argument replacement. Public FileCommitPort unchanged.

reservation_kinds.CatalogLease: short transition only, no callbacks into document owner while held.

U64Decimal.semantic_validation: parse checked u64 <=18446744073709551615; reject JSON number; never JS Number conversion

wire_schema.scope: Every Tauri/JSON request, response and error revision/generation/epoch/count/size/sequence uses U64Decimal when internal type u64. Domain Rust u64 and existing persisted schemas unchanged. Actual design floating-point values remain C1 number policy, not blanket strings.

replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.

request_digest.algorithm: SHA256 of canonical UTF8 of ENTIRE validated request value, including body recursively. No field projection, ignored fields, defaults or post-hash enrichment. Authentication resolves every opaque handle before frozen body assembly. Server resolved identity/content/evidence fields shown in schema are mandatory.
canonicalization: Reject duplicates before object construction; unknown/missing/null outside declared union reject before replay lookup and IO.
Object names sorted by UTF8 bytes. All scalar text valid Unicode scalar values; no normalization.

Strings: quote and backslash escaped, backspace/tab/newline/formfeed/carriage-return as \b/\t/\n/\f/\r; remaining U+0000..001F as lowercase \u00xx; other scalars literal UTF8; no slash escaping/BOM/whitespace.
All integers U64Decimal strings checked in range. No numeric JSON tokens in transition hash schema.
Arrays preserve admitted order, including resolve requests, entries, aliases, roots, evidence and assets. Order changes conflict; do not sort/deduplicate after hashing.

Same key and valid changed body => ReplayConflict before IO; exact same bytes replay retained receipt. Invalid body => InvalidRequest before key lookup. SHA collision resistance assumed, not proved by vectors.
request_digest.excluded: Transport correlation, UI display strings outside declared operation, transient read handles and secrets are not request inputs. Any new behavior-affecting input requires schema/replan; cannot silently exclude.
request_digest.generated_outputs: Pin id created by pin/import is OUTPUT, never caller input. Existing pin_id mandatory for transfer/release. Selection handles freeze full native identity/raw digest/metadata before hash; bundle entries include all admitted metadata and alias mapping.
request_digest.read_only_calls: validate_pin/read_pinned_version/register_roots do not use transition receipt key; authorization and bounds still apply. Provider registration lifecycle unchanged.

replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

proof_registry_record.schema: SGA-MATERIAL-RECEIPT-v1 (new catalog index transition_receipts record; pending schema adoption)

fields.request_digest: SHA256 of full validated SGA-TRANSITION-v2 request; no v1 projected digest accepted as v2 proof
fields.result: Tagged terminal Pin|Imported|Transferred|Released; no runtime DocumentMutation success here
fields.request_protocol: SGA-TRANSITION-v2; new candidate field, existing pending schema proposal only

proof_registry_record.atomicity: Record and pin/root transition in same catalog raw commit. Logical catalog_generation/target_identity verify inclusion without circular embedding of own raw digest. External raw CommitReceipt kept as issuer evidence, not hashed into the same committed bytes.
proof_registry_record.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
proof_registry_record.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

external_issuers.M04: FormalSaveProof requires IO receipt+M05 transfer+captured semantic ACK; runtime owner replay loss => UnverifiedOutcome unless all issuer evidence actually revalidated. MutationReceipt runtime only.
external_issuers.M07: Immutable attempt/payload/index receipt; LocalIntegrityReady independent source ACK.
external_issuers.M01: final path Ready marker and matching digests; not inherited source approval.

store_read_contract.grant: Crate-private trusted constructor in M05 application composition: immutable store_identity,pin_id,workflow_id,asset_id,digest,size,pin_catalog_generation; issued only after verified Held or Transferred pin membership. Released pin denied. Not deserializable from UI.
store_read_contract.preconditions: 0 < max_bytes <= M05 existing admitted blob limit; expected_size<=max_bytes; grant exact pair/size/store matches. Acquire safe native immutable object handle, reject alias/reparse/size/hash mismatch, no path/URI returned as authority.
store_read_contract.result: VerifiedBlobRead {store_identity,digest,size_bytes,immutable bounded bytes or guarded read handle}. Stream exactly expected_size, hash entire bytes before consumer install/export. Handle lifetime owns source access; no reopen-by-path.
store_read_contract.side_effects: No catalog mutation, repair, delete, overwrite, fallback/latest mapping or arbitrary read. Release blocked by retained pin/fence until read operation ends.

mutation_wire_result.precommit_error: {ok:false,error:closed existing error}; zero content commit. Once S1 commit occurred cannot use ErrorUnchanged, undo rollback or failed toast implying no effect.
mutation_wire_result.ui: Show installed revision plus material retention pending; preserve Held, disable unsafe pin release/export until proofs complete. Replay returns original result, never reapply or overwrite newer projection. Writer transfer has separate BindingProjection result, never fabricate mutation/history.

lifecycle.event: same authorized request, binding current, identical body
lifecycle.result: Retained exact outcome; replayed=true; do not reapply, downgrade newer UI projection or revalidate new revision in place of captured revision.
ReplayConflict before any dependency IO; no new ordinal to evade conflict.

lifecycle.event: old binding closed, writer transferred or window instance replaced
lifecycle.result: Validate caller/instance/binding first: UnauthorizedCaller or MissingBinding or StaleOwner; old runtime result is not disclosed to new authority. No resubmit on fresh binding.
Owner finishes already admitted operation under captured authority only; keep evidence/Held. No delivery to stale window. New binding cannot claim same runtime request.

lifecycle.event: process restart or runtime record missing
lifecycle.result: UnverifiedOutcome if admitted request cannot be authenticated in current runtime; old binding normally MissingBinding first. No automatic mutation retry or recreation. Durable issuer lookup is internal authenticated reconciliation only, not new H2 command.

lifecycle.event: authenticated durable material lookup succeeds after restart
lifecycle.result: May establish material transition only; cannot establish runtime install/Undo success or ACK. Fresh owner open and explicit new intent required; prior uncertainty remains recorded.
AppliedRetentionDeferred with original revisions, pin and mutation proof; never rollback, unchanged failure, automatic release or fabricated success.

h2_error_lifecycle.postcommit_stage: LiveRoots for install; UndoRoots for Undo outgoing retention; RedoRoots for retained redo root, according to actual failed root target. Multi-root failure reports first failed stage in declared order LiveRoots,UndoRoots,RedoRoots; retain all unresolved pins.
h2_error_lifecycle.uncertainty: UnverifiedOutcome does not assert zero changes. UI shows outcome unknown and requires reconciliation, preserves draft and disables blind retry. Other precommit failures assert zero content commit only when commit is positively known not attempted.

wire_contract.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_contract.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.
wire_contract.OpaqueId: ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; native/generated fixed-format IDs retain module constraint; actual context server-derived.
wire_contract.Context: Server-derived immutable WorkflowContext {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:U64,captured_revision:U64,workflow_id:UUID}; no transition operation_id in context. Runtime authority never comes from labels/DTO.

cross_owner_proofs.ResolutionSnapshot: {WorkflowContext,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; same immutable workflow across pin/transfer; no transition operation_id in context.
cross_owner_proofs.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer receipt lookup with issuer/kind/WorkflowContext/target/evidence validation per proof_registry_record; no trusted DTO body. Missing runtime-only issuer record => UnverifiedOutcome.
cross_owner_proofs.VerifiedBytes: {digest,size_bytes,immutable_bytes_or_guarded_handle,store_identity}; issued only native/hash validator, not URI/path trust.

replay_protocol.workflow_id: Server UUID minted once per immutable top-level capture. Context equality includes workflow_id; request replay maps authorized caller+session+command+request_id to same workflow. New capture/new authorized request => new workflow.
replay_protocol.operation_id: Internal UUIDv5(namespace=workflow_id, name=UTF8 role + "/" + decimal transition ordinal). Closed role: resolve|pin|import|install|undo|transfer-live|transfer-formal|transfer-recovery|release|publish|ack. Ordinal starts0; request body changes require a new operation ordinal only after explicit new transition, never to bypass conflict.
replay_protocol.key: (issuer,store_identity,workflow_id,operation_id); expected role and immutable context must match. Same key + same request digest returns same persisted receipt. Same key + different digest => ReplayConflict before IO. Prepared/InFlight => InProgress, never another commit.

request_digest.algorithm: SHA256 of canonical UTF8 of ENTIRE validated request value, including body recursively. No field projection, ignored fields, defaults or post-hash enrichment. Authentication resolves every opaque handle before frozen body assembly. Server resolved identity/content/evidence fields shown in schema are mandatory.
canonicalization: Reject duplicates before object construction; unknown/missing/null outside declared union reject before replay lookup and IO.
Object names sorted by UTF8 bytes. All scalar text valid Unicode scalar values; no normalization.

Strings: quote and backslash escaped, backspace/tab/newline/formfeed/carriage-return as \b/\t/\n/\f/\r; remaining U+0000..001F as lowercase \u00xx; other scalars literal UTF8; no slash escaping/BOM/whitespace.
All integers U64Decimal strings checked in range. No numeric JSON tokens in transition hash schema.
Arrays preserve admitted order, including resolve requests, entries, aliases, roots, evidence and assets. Order changes conflict; do not sort/deduplicate after hashing.

Same key and valid changed body => ReplayConflict before IO; exact same bytes replay retained receipt. Invalid body => InvalidRequest before key lookup. SHA collision resistance assumed, not proved by vectors.
request_digest.excluded: Transport correlation, UI display strings outside declared operation, transient read handles and secrets are not request inputs. Any new behavior-affecting input requires schema/replan; cannot silently exclude.
request_digest.generated_outputs: Pin id created by pin/import is OUTPUT, never caller input. Existing pin_id mandatory for transfer/release. Selection handles freeze full native identity/raw digest/metadata before hash; bundle entries include all admitted metadata and alias mapping.
request_digest.read_only_calls: validate_pin/read_pinned_version/register_roots do not use transition receipt key; authorization and bounds still apply. Provider registration lifecycle unchanged.

replay_protocol.runtime_commands: Existing H2 request records remain runtime-only 128/binding,1024/runtime; no eviction and no durable exactly-once claim. Runtime loss => UnverifiedOutcome; never reconstruct mutation success from pin receipt alone.
replay_protocol.resume: Verify issuer durable store + exact target identity/raw/catalog evidence. Terminal receipt returns retained result; uncertain prepared record stays Indeterminate/Held. No automatic IO retry, rollback, ACK or release on missing evidence.
replay_protocol.new_persistence: M05 transition_receipts map joins the same single catalog index CAS as pin/root state. New pending schema change, not existing capability. Other issuers retain actual existing durable IO/recovery/copy receipts; do not introduce a global proof database.

issuer_proof_records.schema: SGA-MATERIAL-RECEIPT-v1 (new catalog index transition_receipts record; pending schema adoption)

fields.request_digest: SHA256 of full validated SGA-TRANSITION-v2 request; no v1 projected digest accepted as v2 proof
fields.result: Tagged terminal Pin|Imported|Transferred|Released; no runtime DocumentMutation success here
fields.request_protocol: SGA-TRANSITION-v2; new candidate field, existing pending schema proposal only

issuer_proof_records.atomicity: Record and pin/root transition in same catalog raw commit. Logical catalog_generation/target_identity verify inclusion without circular embedding of own raw digest. External raw CommitReceipt kept as issuer evidence, not hashed into the same committed bytes.
issuer_proof_records.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
issuer_proof_records.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

external_issuers.M04: FormalSaveProof requires IO receipt+M05 transfer+captured semantic ACK; runtime owner replay loss => UnverifiedOutcome unless all issuer evidence actually revalidated. MutationReceipt runtime only.
external_issuers.M07: Immutable attempt/payload/index receipt; LocalIntegrityReady independent source ACK.
external_issuers.M01: final path Ready marker and matching digests; not inherited source approval.

v3_schema_roots.interpretation: Each named FILE is schema root, never DTO prose subtree or ModuleSpec. Local refs resolve within file. No network resolution.

model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

digest_domains.GenerationApproval: sha256:lowerhex64 exact sorted approved refs evidence projection
digest_domains.FileRaw/CatalogRaw/ArchiveRaw/PayloadRaw: separate typed lowerhex64; no semantic comparison; wrap prefix only explicit S1 boundary

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.
model.ResolutionSnapshot: Asset/version binding validation only; NOT root completeness or durable pin. Complete requires every requested version/target answered with exact context; unknown reference-bearing fields reject mutation.
model.PinReceipt: {catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,pin_id,Context,purpose,versions_digest,issuer_receipt_id}; only M05 creates after durable catalog proof. Consumer validate_pin verifies current Held or explicitly valid transfer state plus context. No UI mint/TTL.
model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.
phases: RejectedBeforeMutation (content unchanged; safe staged/orphan assets may retained)
DeliveryDeferred (verified committed result not delivered to old owner)
model.lock_order: No owner callback while holding catalog/index/active IO lease. Content capture under owner reservation then release; catalog pin transition under short catalog lease then release; external write then release; root transfer separate; matching ACK last. Generation special held SOURCE read reservations acquired before active writer and released after receipt; producer updates Busy/defer (pending choice). Project copy final-path quarantine avoids moving journals.

matrix.after: RecoverySnapshots root transfer→S1 Published+captured recovery ACK

model.precedence: v2 common definitions replace v1 common and exact listed module pointers only after Owner adoption. Original embedded behavior rows are historical trace, not competing runtime protocol. Context means WorkflowContext, operation_id means TransitionKey.operation_id at every material call. No in-place update to original Approved artifacts.

wire_types.U64Decimal: JSON STRING regex^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$, checked0..18446744073709551615; no plus/leading-zero/exponent/space. Rust u64 internal. JS keeps string/BigInt; never Number roundtrip.
wire_types.Digest: {domain,profile?,lowerhex64}; sha256: prefix only existing M01/M02 S1 boundaries. No arbitrary cross-domain conversion.
wire_types.OpaqueId: ASCII[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}; native/generated fixed-format IDs retain module constraint; actual context server-derived.
wire_types.Context: Server-derived immutable WorkflowContext {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:U64,captured_revision:U64,workflow_id:UUID}; no transition operation_id in context. Runtime authority never comes from labels/DTO.

material_api.import: import(WorkflowContext,TrustedSourceSelection,ImportMetadata,TransitionKey)->ImportedPinnedManifest; native source bytes verified before durable immutable import; no UI path authority
material_api.register_roots: register_roots(TrustedProviderCapability,RootKind)->RootRegistration; internal trusted composition only; no UI registration/callback
material_api.publish_roots: publish_roots(RootRegistration,expected_epoch:u64,RootManifest,TransitionKey)->RootObservationReceipt; owner provider attests current fenced manifest; stale epoch => StaleRoots, unknown => Unknown not empty

proof_types.ResolutionSnapshot: {WorkflowContext,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness:Complete,assets,bindings}; same immutable workflow across pin/transfer; no transition operation_id in context.
proof_types.AuthenticatedExternalProof: Opaque issuer receipt lookup with issuer/kind/WorkflowContext/target/evidence validation per proof_registry_record; no trusted DTO body. Missing runtime-only issuer record => UnverifiedOutcome.
proof_types.VerifiedBytes: {digest,size_bytes,immutable_bytes_or_guarded_handle,store_identity}; issued only native/hash validator, not URI/path trust.

quarantine_copy.marker: .sgenaxis/copy-state.v1.json; {schema:SGA-PROJECT-COPY-v1,project_uuid,operation_id,state:Quarantined|Ready,definition_raw_digest?,document_raw_digest?,catalog_raw_digest?,manifest_digest?}. Strict duplicate/unknown/type/project validation; quarantine written durably before any public project manifest/definition/document/catalog.
quarantine_copy.sequence: Exclusive create FINAL target directory (never rename it after any FileCommit operation) → create Quarantined marker via checked IO → initialize validated children/catalog/pins at FINAL paths → verify full copy proofs → CAS Ready marker with exact digests → authenticate M01 open/bind. Source approvals provenance only; new project+doc identities.
quarantine_copy.reader_gate: All official M01 open/adopt/select and startup recovery check copy marker before S2 bind; Quarantined/invalid/uncertain journal refuses project readiness. Marker absent allows existing legacy policy only if no partial-copy evidence; empty/unmarked exclusive-copy crash residue is not adopted automatically. Existing accepted S2 public API unchanged; new application wrapper gate is proposed.
quarantine_copy.failure: Before Ready no selectable completed project; retains quarantined diagnostic+pins. After Ready delivery loss returns ProjectCopyDeliveryDeferred; no rollback/delete. Never rewrite/move private journal to fix path binding.

source_reservation.application_trait: SourceReadReservation: snapshot_id()->SourceSnapshotId; validate_held()->Result<SourceSnapshotId,SourceFenceError>; explicit release(self). Owns authenticated snapshot identity+held producer read capability; cannot be constructed from DTO. Drop releases handles only.
source_reservation.native_trait: CommittedReadPort.acquire_read(trusted_target_capability)->CommittedReadLease; lease.read_verified(max_bytes)->VerifiedCommittedBytes; lease owns OS shared lock compatible with existing FileCommit exclusive writer, normalized target+readonly journal validation. No create/repair/cleanup. Missing sidecar =>Unavailable.
source_reservation.producer_rules: Definition/design owner read reservation blocks their mutation and exclusive file writer until generation terminal result; acquire definition→approval HOST epoch→design before active writer. Immutable SPEC Approved revisions remain pure; HOST epoch covers evidence validity changes, not a SPEC filesystem dependency. All producer mutation routes must honor reservation; incomplete coverage =>DependencyNotReady.
source_reservation.io_guard: IO-owned crate-private CommittedReadGuard unforgeable outside adapter constructor. inspect_committed_locked(&CommittedReadGuard)->Result<CommittedReadInspection,CommitError>; validates guard-bound canonical target/terminal journal/current raw digest, no path argument replacement. Public FileCommitPort unchanged.
source_reservation.scope: New committed_read.rs ports/adapter/native tests plus generation_sources.rs application provider adapters. Only proposed exact child files below; accepted IO implementation not re-approved automatically.

recovery_readiness.PublicationAcknowledged: Original M05 root transfer receipt and original captured S1 Published/ACK verified.
recovery_readiness.restore: LocalIntegrityReady permits explicit restore to authorized destination even SourceRetentionDeferred. mutation_wire_result.precommit_error: {ok:false,error:closed existing error}; zero content commit. Once S1 commit occurred cannot use ErrorUnchanged, undo rollback or failed toast implying no effect.

model.identity: ProjectUuid UUIDv4 from trusted M01 authority. DocumentUuid denotes physical document owner identity; SessionId/OwnerGeneration/RequestId scoped runtime. AssetId opaque immutable project namespace; version=(AssetId,ContentDigest). SnapshotId/GenerationId never substitute document/session. New-copy and restored unsaved documents receive fresh doc/session identity; content entity IDs only explicit format policy/preview changes. Foreign approvals retained as provenance, not authority.

model.Context: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,operation_id}; exactly matched by every pin/proof/apply. UI decimal-string transport per CX03; server context authoritative.

model.RootManifest: {provider_id,epoch,scope,kind,source_revision,completeness,references,evidence_receipt_id}. Five kinds exactly accepted S1: LiveDocuments(including persisted formal docs),UndoHistory,RedoHistory,RecoverySnapshots,InFlightTransactions. Aggregate any missing component=>Unknown; no release/GC inference from Complete material resolution.
model.ExternalCommitProof: Tagged FormalFile|RecoveryIndex|DocumentMutation|ProjectCopyReady|GenerationActivation|ArchiveExport with issuer-owned proof record, Context and typed byte/projection references. Different tag cannot satisfy another use case. Committed receipt verification checks target identity/path, expected prior Option raw hash,new raw hash,transaction ID; then cross-owner transfer, then corresponding ACK.

request_digest.algorithm: SHA256 of canonical UTF8 of ENTIRE validated request value, including body recursively. No field projection, ignored fields, defaults or post-hash enrichment. canonicalization: Reject duplicates before object construction; unknown/missing/null outside declared union reject before replay lookup and IO.

All integers U64Decimal strings checked in range. No numeric JSON tokens in transition hash schema.
Arrays preserve admitted order, including resolve requests, entries, aliases, roots, evidence and assets. Order changes conflict; do not sort/deduplicate after hashing.

Same key and valid changed body => ReplayConflict before IO; exact same bytes replay retained receipt. Invalid body => InvalidRequest before key lookup. SHA collision resistance assumed, not proved by vectors.

read_verified_blob.preconditions: 0 < max_bytes <= M05 existing admitted blob limit; expected_size<=max_bytes; grant exact pair/size/store matches. Acquire safe native immutable object handle, reject alias/reparse/size/hash mismatch, no path/URI returned as authority.
read_verified_blob.result: VerifiedBlobRead {store_identity,digest,size_bytes,immutable bounded bytes or guarded read handle}. Stream exactly expected_size, hash entire bytes before consumer install/export. Handle lifetime owns source access; no reopen-by-path.
read_verified_blob.side_effects: No catalog mutation, repair, delete, overwrite, fallback/latest mapping or arbitrary read. Release blocked by retained pin/fence until read operation ends.

after.forbidden: No arbitrary path reads, remove/overwrite/repair or public FileCommitPort change

previous_cx_differences.before: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_uuid,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,caller_binding}; authenticated by MaterialOwner, not Tauri user fields.
previous_cx_differences.after: Server-derived immutable WorkflowContext {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_id,owner_generation:U64,captured_revision:U64,workflow_id:UUID}; no transition operation_id in context. Runtime authority never comes from labels/DTO.

after.schema: SGA-MATERIAL-RECEIPT-v1 (new catalog index transition_receipts record; pending schema adoption)

fields.result: Tagged terminal Pin|Imported|Transferred|Released; no runtime DocumentMutation success here

after.atomicity: Record and pin/root transition in same catalog raw commit. Logical catalog_generation/target_identity verify inclusion without circular embedding of own raw digest. External raw CommitReceipt kept as issuer evidence, not hashed into the same committed bytes.
after.trust: Resolve receipt_id only server-side under native store identity+verified catalog raw bytes. UI-supplied receipt body never authoritative. Cross-store/context/action mismatch => ProofMismatch.
after.retention: No receipt eviction or pin timeout in this slice. Input/index limits from M05 remain; full index => CapacityExceeded before mutation; compaction/GC separate proposal.

external_issuers.M04: FormalSaveProof requires IO receipt+M05 transfer+captured semantic ACK; runtime owner replay loss => UnverifiedOutcome unless all issuer evidence actually revalidated. MutationReceipt runtime only.
external_issuers.M07: Immutable attempt/payload/index receipt; LocalIntegrityReady independent source ACK.
external_issuers.M01: final path Ready marker and matching digests; not inherited source approval.

after.material_import: trusted source selection → import → immutable blob receipt → catalog pin+receipt same CAS
after.export_or_snapshot: validate_pin → issue private VerifiedStorePinGrant → driven read_verified_blob → verify bytes → consumer
after.registration: trusted application composition → register_roots; closed RootKind LiveDocuments|UndoRedo|FormalDocuments|RecoverySnapshots|ExportImportOperations
after.publish: provider current epoch/fence → publish_roots; stale/Unknown does not authorize release

after.default_for_declared_internal_u64: All other proposed UI inputs/outputs/errors with typed u64 field must use common U64Decimal; source format numeric data/persisted schema excluded. Exact command DTO fixture coverage remains acceptance gate, not inferred from prose.
